audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was written as unconditional ('even clean Alpha dodges do not save him from the full combo'), and the two later spikes carried no cooldowns.
audit.why: Alpha Strike makes Master Yi untargetable for its flight on a 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s cooldown that his basic attacks shorten, so a Culling channelled as he casts is simply lost. Highlander is a flat 85s and makes him immune to slows.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4], whys[6] and 'mid' now key the ult to his blink — channel after he lands, not as he casts — and Highlander's 85s and slow immunity are stated.
sources: enemyKit Master Yi Q cd and untargetable flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed The Culling beats Alpha Strike dodges. It does not — Alpha Strike is untargetable. Wuju Style's true damage and Meditate's healing were also absent.
audit.why: Riot's Alpha Strike text: 'teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable'. Riot's Wuju Style: 'Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks' — so armour is the wrong buy against him. Meditate restores health and reduces damage taken on a flat 10s and is a CHANNEL, meaning it is interruptible, which is the real counterplay and matters more than out-damaging it.
audit.corrected: The untargetable window written into whys[4], spikes[1].text and 'mid'; Wuju Style's true damage into whys[5]; Meditate's heal and 10s cooldown into spikes[2].text.
sources: enemyKit Master Yi Q/W/E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'Piercing Light' in whys[0] as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Piercing Light is the real Riot name of Lucian's Q. False positive in suspectNames.
